local_address: Sherpur Upazila, Bogura District, Rajshahi Division
idea_description: Developing low-cost smart soil moisture sensors with solar-powered automatic drip valves for potato and vegetable farmers in Bogura. The prototype reduces water and electricity consumption by 38% and can be monitored via local SIM SMS alerts without requiring high-speed smartphone internet.
admin_notes: Strong agronomy background. Scheduled preliminary WhatsApp technical review.

idea_description: Bio-organic bacterial seed coating that increases saline tolerance of coastal rice varieties (BRRI dhan 67) during early germination in Khulna and Satkhira delta soils. Initial lab trials demonstrated a 24% increase in seedling survival rates under 8 dS/m salinity.
admin_notes: Impressive biotech thesis work. Consider connecting with BAU genomics lab residency.

idea_description: Decentralized micro cold-storage powered by mini solar-biogas hybrid generators, located directly at wholesale fish and tomato assembly points. Helps rural smallholders preserve perishable harvests for up to 14 days to prevent distressed middleman sales.
admin_notes: Needs detailed bill-of-materials and refrigeration unit economics.
